headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.12
summary: This release makes the AI crash analysis pleasant to read and safer to configure: responses now render as markdown with colored code tokens, the result dialog gets a compact top-right close button and a friendly loading state, and a Base URL without a scheme no longer crashes the launcher.

items.text: AI analysis responses now render as markdown with colored code tokens (keywords green, exceptions orange, URLs blue), the result dialog swaps the bottom close button for a compact top-right X that suits low-DPI landscape screens, and a proper loading dialog with a spinner shows while the AI reads your log.

Fixed a crash when fetching the AI model list with a Base URL missing the http(s):// scheme: the launcher now defaults scheme-less hosts to https and reports request errors through a toast instead of crashing.
